hook.name: HooksToken
hook.description: Combined ERC-20 token (HOOKS) and Uniswap v4 hook for a single bound HOOKS/ETH pool. Charges immutable buy/sell fees on the ETH leg via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, splits proceeds among holder ETH rewards and two treasury addresses, and maintains a "build state" mechanic that completes cycles as qualifying HOOKS buys accumulate.
